# Copilot Instructions

This repository stores MRI lecture notes and slides authored in Quarto.

## Repository structure

- `notes/`: lecture-note `.qmd` files for HTML/PDF rendering.
- `slides/`: slide-deck `.qmd` files (typically `revealjs`).
- `slides/images/`: image assets exported from PowerPoint decks for use in Quarto slides.
- `_quarto.yml`: shared rendering defaults.

## Authoring guidance

- Prefer Quarto (`.qmd`) for all new notes and slides.
- Keep source text and slide assets organized by lecture/topic.
- Use relative paths for local assets.
- Keep changes focused and minimal.
